svg.title: Social bookmarking: a read-heavy tagging system
svg.desc: Social bookmarking service architecture showing clients hitting a load balancer and application servers, which read from a cache holding hot tag and user timelines, a bookmarks database sharded by user ID, and a separate inverted tag index used to answer tag search queries.
